releases.name: Pajamastan Card Orders 2026-11-23
releases.body: Created the card order backend. It stores card images, opens a card payment checkout, and has an order page for the owner.

jobs.description: Backend that stores card images, opens a checkout, and shows orders to the owner.

releases.name: Estate Dossier 2026-11-24
releases.body: Created Estate Dossier. It has a radial map and a list view of exposures, triage, tasks, an intake wizard, a broker state machine, and exports. A sign in gate was added, with encrypted storage for each account and sync between devices.

jobs.description: A private dossier that maps where your personal information is exposed and tracks what to do.

releases.name: Starwake 2026-11-24
releases.body: Added a visual pass with nebulae, a living Bloom edge, star tints and halos, a ringed planet, engine trails, shot glow, and shockwaves.

releases.name: Starwake 2026-11-23
releases.body: Created Starwake, a game on a printed style star chart. It replaced the earlier Spy Hunt page. A balance pass after playtesting added Bloom warnings, gentler scouts, better income, an exact arrival day, and a favicon.

jobs.description: A star chart strategy game where a grey Bloom spreads across the map.

releases.name: FileCensus 2026-11-24
releases.body: Created FileCensus, an Android app with a file inventory, file details, notes on AI made files, a timeline, and tags. It then gained a duplicate finder and built in visualizers, including a Circuit mode. A board view now draws the whole file catalog, with a look for each file, and the audio Circuit mode was removed. Deleting is now safer, with a review step, a native confirm, a restorable trash, and a separate erase step.

jobs.description: An Android app that takes a census of the files on your phone.

releases.name: Conveyor Sim 2026-11-23
releases.body: Every label now leads with what the machine is in software, like Web server, Database or Cron job, with the factory picture second. This covers the floor, the machine card, the tabs, and the build hints.

releases.name: Conveyor Sim 2026-11-22
releases.body: You can now build a factory from the stacks made in the pipeline builder. Teardown layers are accepted by name, then detail, then category. The machine info card pops up above the tapped machine, scales with your zoom, and stops growing past a readable size.

jobs.description: A conveyor simulation started from a copy of the agent test bed

releases.name: Explode 2026-11-23
releases.body: Created Explode, a photo app. Pick a photo, tap anything in it to cut that object out as a piece, then slide to explode the pieces apart and drag them around. Later the same day it gained one by one explode mode, bubbles and deeper cuts, callout labels, toward and away slide directions, pinch zoom and pan, a ping-pong Play with typed out labels, and a Focus mode with a background fade.

jobs.description: A photo toy that cuts objects out of a picture and spreads the pieces apart.

releases.name: PDF Text Editor 2026-11-23
releases.body: Added signatures and initials. Draw once, tap a line to auto fit, drag and resize, and the result is flattened into the download. Scanned and photo PDFs can now be signed, and tilted or broken scan lines are followed better. A Text box tool and a bottom Remove bar for placed items were added. Resizing is smoother, with plus and minus buttons that repeat when held.

jobs.description: Open a PDF, tap a line of text, and change what it says without leaving your device

releases.name: Field Twin Viridian 2026-11-23
releases.body: Added a sideways layout with the camera on the left. A rotate button holds the screen sideways or upright or lets it turn. A dark screen button dims the screen and keeps it on while the camera and plate reader run.

jobs.description: A field twin app that reads plates and keeps a list of sightings.

releases.name: Hire Portal 2026-11-23
releases.body: Added an open positions page with a fully remote Data Collection Specialist posting beside the Systems Support Technician posting. Added a Prove you are human face check where the applicant looks straight, turns left, turns right, and looks straight again. Applications now send to a shared database project, with the badge photo sent when it is chosen. An application that cannot send waits on the device. A menu holds an Applications inbox where an owner signs in to read, open, and download every application.

jobs.description: A practice job application that teaches applicants what to share and what to withhold

releases.name: Strudel Samples 2026-11-24
releases.body: Added a pad board page that loads every clip from the map. Pick clips from a library menu, set each pad's start point by dragging its waveform or typing seconds, and turn on chain mode so each pad plays the next one when it ends. The board layout saves itself in the browser, and the site root opens the board.

releases.name: Hush 2026-11-23
releases.body: Blocked notifications that refuse a plain cancel are now snoozed instead.

jobs.description: An Android app that blocks notifications and releases them in a digest.
